_provenance.method: Extracted by scripts/extract-nasr-airport.ts MHT KMHT: rows with ARPT_ID/FACILITY_ID == MHT copied verbatim, only numeric conversion applied. Charted magnetic runway headings are read from the airport diagram (see airport_diagram.charted_runway_headings_mag in kmht-procedures.json).

threshold.note: NASR RWY_END_LAT/LONG = the physical runway end (pavement end). The simulator uses it as the runway-end node; a displaced landing threshold, where one exists, is listed in displaced_threshold.

displaced_threshold.note: NASR DISPLACED_THR_LEN: landing threshold displaced from the pavement end (the displaced area is usable for takeoff, taxi and landing rollout). Not modelled by the simulator beyond this record.
